description: Shared contract for Electron Forge release asset names. Consumed by CI verification and the site install wizard (do not invent alternate filenames).

windows.wizard: Squirrel.Windows Setup.exe (loading GIF + setup icon; silent per-user install under %LocalAppData%)
windows.notes: Site wizards must link the *.Setup.exe asset only. RELEASES/nupkg are for Squirrel auto-update, not end-user download CTAs.

macos.wizard: ZIP archive; user opens .app from Finder (no signed DMG/notarization in this pipeline)

linux.wizard: Native package managers (.deb via apt/dpkg, .rpm via dnf/yum)

commands.ciPublish: Push an annotated tag after bumping package.json version above the previous release (currently latest is v2.1.0).
